condition_population.note: the replicated-condition population is not a random subset of the source: repeats concentrate on multi-plate, multi-article conditions

delta_source.definition: delta = X - matched control (mean of normalized vehicles)

noise_floor.definition: sqrt(mean over genes of the within-condition per-gene variance of Delta, ddof=1)

noise_floor_population.definition: sqrt(mean over genes of the within-condition per-gene variance of Delta, ddof=0) = RMS deviation from the condition mean; the variant that reproduces ADR 0082

pcc_ceiling.definition: profile-weighted mean of sqrt(rho_c) over replicated conditions
pcc_ceiling.input_condition_population: every replicated condition of the source
pcc_ceiling.label: heuristic diagnostic
pcc_ceiling.note: heuristic diagnostic, not a measurement-error model; the input conditions are not a random subset of the source

repeat_correlation.definition: per condition: mean pairwise Pearson correlation of the member Delta vectors over genes; per source: the median
